label: Embedded Systems & Electronics
cardNote: 🔌 Where software has to meet the physical world
headline: Circuit, board, and device software
developed together and tested on real hardware.
summary: On device projects, I do not treat software and hardware as separate jobs. I turn the requirements into a circuit, interfaces, and software, bring up the prototype, and use measurement and debugging until the device works reliably in real conditions.

freelance: Designed electronics and device interfaces and built configuration tools for Windows, Linux, and the web.
Built and brought up prototypes and debugged the circuit, firmware, and operating system until the device behaved reliably.
security: Performed security analysis, penetration testing, and vulnerability assessment for government infrastructure and wrote patches for some issues.
Prepared repeatable examples and check steps so the infrastructure team could test each fix themselves.
company: Worked on mobile and web applications with NoSQL databases and service APIs.
Took part in design, implementation, integration debugging, and final delivery.
